test_objective: Check that one can add a hosted @context

test_cases.name: 050_01_01 Add a valid hosted @context from key=value
test_cases.doc: Check that one can add a @context
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Add a new @context with Response Status Code set to 201     and
        Add a new @context with Response does not contain a body     and
        Add a new @context with Response reason set to 'Created'     and
        Serve a @context with Check that the Kind of the @context is set to 'Hosted'
}

test_cases.name: 050_01_02 Add a valid cached @context from URI
test_cases.doc: Check that one can add a @context
test_cases.then:
then {

        Add a new @context with Response reason set to 'Created'     and

}
